# 1g: web UI

## Read first

- `docs/ui/design/`: the exported screens, `tokens.css` and its README. This step can't start before they exist.
- [ui/design-brief.md](../ui/design-brief.md), [architecture.md](../architecture.md) sections HTTP API and Events.
- The As built sections of [1b](1b.md), [1d](1d.md), [1e](1e.md) and [1f](1f.md).

## Done when

- The Vue app implements every screen in the design, in both themes and at phone width, with live updates.
- `make web-check` passes.
- A local run with `SHELF_DEV_FAKE_SOURCE=true` passes the UI part of the checklist below.
- The browser console shows no CSP violations on any screen.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stack | Vue 3 with `<script setup>`, Vite, TypeScript, Vue Router, Pinia, Vitest and `@vue/test-utils`. No component library. | The design defines the components. |
| Styles | `tokens.css` from the design as the base, then one stylesheet per component through Vue's scoped styles. No inline `style` attributes in templates; dynamic values go through CSS variables set from script. | The strict CSP. |
| Fonts | Self-hosted files under `web/public/fonts`. | `font-src 'self'`. |
| Routes | `/search`, `/downloads`, `/downloads/:id`, `/status`. `/` redirects to `/search`. | The shell's sections. |
| Stores | `sources` holds capabilities, formats and health. `search` holds the query, source, type and pages per source. `downloads` holds lists and details. `events` owns the `EventSource`. | Small, separate state. |
| Live updates | One `EventSource` on `/api/events`. On reconnect the stores reload what they show. A download panel opens its own log stream. | architecture.md: the stream has no replay. |
| Links in the search field | A value that parses as a Qobuz or Apple Music URL calls `/api/resolve` instead of searching. | The brief. |
| Covers | Apple artwork templates get the size the cell shows, times the device pixel ratio. Qobuz covers use the sizes the API offers. | Sharp covers without large files. |
| Keyboard | Tables keep a row cursor: arrow keys move it, Enter opens the panel, Escape closes it. | The brief's keyboard rule. |
| Theme | Follows the system; a switch in the shell saves the choice in `localStorage`. | The brief. |

## Pages

| Route | Design screens | API |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/search` | Search, album panel, artist panel, resolved link, search states | `/api/sources`, `/api/search`, `/api/resolve`, `/api/items`, `POST /api/downloads` |
| `/downloads`, `/downloads/:id` | Downloads, download panel | `/api/downloads`, `/api/downloads/{id}`, `/log`, `/cancel`, `/retry`, `/api/library/scan` |
| `/status` | Status, sign-in dialog | `/api/sources`, `/api/applemusic/wrapper/*`, `/api/library/scan` |

## Doc changes

`docs/ui/design/README.md` notes where the app differs from the canvas; `docs/status.md`.

## Checklist

| Edge case | Test |
| --- | --- |
| Badge text for every quality in the brief | `quality.test.ts` |
| Qobuz and Apple Music URLs are recognised; other text is a query | `links.test.ts` |
| A `download` event updates the right row and the running count | `downloads.store.test.ts` |
| A reconnect reloads the lists | `events.store.test.ts` |
| The format menu lists the source's formats with the default first | `formatMenu.test.ts` |
| Durations, sizes and "3 minutes ago" render as in the design | `format.test.ts` |
| The sign-in dialog moves from credentials to code to done, and shows the timeout | `signin.test.ts` |
| Search, panels, downloads, status and sign-in work against the fake source | manual, recorded in `docs/status.md` |
| No CSP violations on any screen | manual, browser console |
